CRITIQUE_POINTS:
1) The “unknown / packing-controlled” conclusion is plausibly consistent with the available photophysics being solid-only (E71) with medium reliability and no environment contrast (E72, E73). However, the writeup implicitly assumes an AIE “turn-on” without any measured solution vs aggregate/solid comparison; with only E71/E72 this is not yet evidenced.
2) ESIPT is correctly disfavored using motif negatives (no intramolecular H-bond motif and no tautomerizable motif; E51, E52). This is one of the strongest mechanistic eliminations in the pack.
3) The structural argument against TICT (low torsional change E31; low overall relaxation E37; high rigidity proxy E39) is suggestive but not definitive. aTB trends reflect one optimized S1 geometry relative to S0; a TICT mechanism can be controlled by access/barriers and multiple minima rather than large relaxation at the chosen minimum. As-is, E31/E37 mainly argue “no large S0→S1 twist in the computed minimum,” not “no TICT channel exists.”
4) The ICT/CT discussion could be tightened by explicitly incorporating the other CT-adjacent cues: weak donor–acceptor path strength (E50), low electronic redistribution score/magnitude (E35, E36), and very small permanent dipole change (E62). These collectively support “weak CT character,” which may map better to “neutral aromatic/LE-like” than to “unknown,” depending on how “neutral aromatic” is defined in your label taxonomy.
